label: Claude Fable 5.2
output:
To: @marco
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: none

Marco. Desert Palms. You told me Saturday it was 14 units all good. Its not all good. There is not one code in the sheet for that job. Lupe looked this morning. The last thing you logged was Ortiz Tire on the 12th.

Yvette called at 7:50. Tenant in 9B lost her key and wants 3 copies today, and I got nothing to cut from. So now the shop looks stupid in front of a customer over a job we finished two days ago.

She also says theres a black pinning tray with pins in it sitting on the counter in the leasing office. Thats my tray. It sat in a customers office all weekend.

Im pissed and I want you to know it. This is not the first time. Kessler job in September was the same thing and I told you then. I put it out to everybody back in August. Codes go in the sheet same day, before you leave the van. That is not optional and it never was.

Heres what happens today. You go back out to Desert Palms. You decode 9B first and get me that code the minute you have it so I can cut Yvettes keys. Then you do the rest of building B, all 14 if you can get into them. Every one goes in the sheet with the unit number before you leave the property. And you bring my tray back.

If you got those codes written down someplace already, tell me right now and get them in the sheet. You still go get the tray.

Im not letting you go over this. Youre good with your hands and I want you here. But this cant keep happening and I dont want to have this talk again.

Tell me when youre headed out there.
